mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing F_PermissionMatrix removes the closed-world assignment of allowed cells, freeing the PermMatrix.Allowed relation to contain any Role->OperationKind pairs. The injection then forces a forbidden cell into the Allowed set, directly violating LeastPrivilege and PermissionGrounding.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_PermMatrixViolation { ComplianceReviewer -> PostDecision in PermMatrix.Allowed }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing F_OneInFlightPerCustomer removes the constraint that prevents a customer from having two simultaneous in-flight applications. The injection forces two distinct applications with the same customer to both be in-flight, producing the exact counterexample FR-008 was designed to prevent.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_TwoInFlightViolation { some disj a1, a2: LoanApplication | a1.appCustomer = a2.appCustomer and a1.appStatus = Submitted and a2.appStatus = UnderReview }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing F_DecisionByAssignedOfficer removes the structural constraint binding a Decision's decidedBy to the application's assignedOfficer. The injection forces a Decision where the deciding user is different from the assigned officer, directly violating FR-013.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_WrongOfficerDecides { some d: Decision | some u: User | u.userRole = LoanOfficer and u != d.forApp.assignedOfficer and d.decidedBy = u }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing F_AuditNoDuplicateTransitions removes the append-only guard that prevents duplicate (previousStatus, newStatus) pairs for the same application. The injection forces two audit entries on the same application with identical transition fields, violating the append-only and exactly-one-per-transition invariants.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_DuplicateAuditEntry { some disj e1, e2: AuditEntry | e1.auditApp = e2.auditApp and e1.previousStatus = e2.previousStatus and e1.newStatus = e2.newStatus }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing F_AuditValidTransitions removes the constraint that limits audit entries to the four documented transitions. The injection introduces an audit entry recording a transition out of a terminal state (Approved→Rejected), which represents the exact immutability violation FR-016 forbids.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_InvalidTransition { some e: AuditEntry | e.previousStatus = Approved and e.newStatus = Rejected }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing F_AuditSubmitActorIsCustomer allows the initial audit entry's actor to be a non-customer user. The injection forces an initial submission entry (no previousStatus) where the actor is a LoanOfficer, violating attribution correctness and the invariant that only the owning customer can appear as actor on the submission event.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_WrongSubmitActor { some e: AuditEntry | no e.previousStatus and e.auditActor.userRole = LoanOfficer }
